text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algiers' residents bravely endure bombing campaign.
- Workers' union leader Abdelhaq Benhamouda wants to reshape the political map through his planned political party.
- A bomb kills eight and wounds 10 in Blida.
- The government adopts a draft law on worker retirement.
- A bomb kills two and wounds many in Blida.
- A car bomb kills seven near Boufarik town, south of Algiers.
- The Transitional National Council holds session on Saturday to vote party and election laws.
